input.subject: Buyer profile attached - luxury condo, Chelsea/WV, $4-5M
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Sharing my buyer's full profile (attached) rather than retyping it. She's exclusive with me, pre-approved, and highly motivated. Please review and send anything relevant - coming soon and off-market especially welcome. Co-broke 2.5%.

Warmly,
Nathalie Brooks
Compass
